item.description:
Release v5.22.0

Changes since v5.21.0

  • docs(agent-loop): add tool job orchestration plan
  • docs(tool-job): document runtime operations and recovery
  • feat: add agent plan storage plugin
  • feat: add always allow tool approval action
  • feat: optimize context compaction lifecycle
  • feat: show context compaction timeline events
  • feat(agent-loop): resume turns from tool job events
  • feat(agent-tool): add cancellable execution context
  • feat(app-store-connect): restore App Store Connect plugin
  • feat(model-selector): notify model switch via kernel toast
  • feat(perf): add centralized metrics provider
  • feat(PluginAppStoreConnect): localize size and relation format strings
  • feat(PluginChatPanel): persist and restore active Rail tab on Chat activation
  • feat(PluginConversationContextSize): add token usage and context window localization
  • feat(RailView): add Observer event mechanism and remove ObservableObject from protocol
  • feat(RailView): add Observer event mechanism to RailViewProviding
  • feat(shell-tool): stream output through tool context
  • feat(tool-job): add cancellable execution manager
  • feat(tool-job): define observable tool job contracts
  • feat(tool-job): persist and recover execution state
